title: Packers Pro Bowler says he's 'being punished' by team's CB competition

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Packers Pro Bowler says he's 'being punished' by team's CB competition
sources.description: Keisean Nixon is in a battle for a starting job with the Green Bay Packers. The 2025 Pro Bowler believes the battle reflects him "being punished."
